item.title: fix(auth): inherit the shared auth store once it owns credentials (#1…
item.summary: fix(auth): inherit the shared auth store once it owns credentials (#130264) * fix(auth): inherit the shared auth store once it owns credentials resolveLegacyInheritedAuthDir unconditionally selected the legacy main-agent directory as the read-through base, so on fresh installs (and post-relocation installs) the empty agent DB shadowed the canonical shared auth store: models auth paste-api-key printed success while every turn failed with missing-provider-auth. The resolver now returns the legacy directory only while resolveSharedAuthStoreOwnership reports legacy-main ownership; otherwise inheritance read-throughs to the shared store per docs/auth-credential-semantics.md. Sibling shadow sites in the models list catalog paths fixed with the same predicate; stale AGENTS.md security line corrected. Regression proves fresh shared credentials resolve with no agent-local profile, populated legacy stores stay authoritative pre-relocation, and local profiles still override the shared base. * test(gateway): reset shared discovery state in the fixture-reset owner The chat.history thinkingDefault regression on CI was a pre-existing isolate:false leak: a sibling test's agentDiscoveryMock catalog
